notes.title: v1.11 - Content Update 1.1
notes.notes:
- Added subtitles and localization for the remaining 6 episodes of TV content.
- Fixed control-related and navigational issues with one of the endings.
- Fixed blue box appearing when TAB key is pressed.
- Fixed setting values not correctly updating when the language has changed.

notes.title: v1.10 - Content Update 1
notes.notes:
- Added input binding for the 3 interaction buttons.
- Added a dynamic crosshair visual to show which of the interaction buttons are active at any given time.
- Added sfx for breaking objects.
- Added sfx for shower, work clock, and throwing items into the trash bin.
- Added 6 more episodes of TV content.
- Added subtitles and localization for 9 more episodes of TV content.
- Added adventurer cassettes, with subtitles and localization.
- Disabled being able to throw searchlight into the trash bin.

notes.title: v1.09 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
This will be the last hotfix before a bigger content update that will take us a while to release.
Thank you for your patience <3

!!! Some save games might be broken after this update since there are removed days. We recommend a fresh new game for the ones who will return to their game !!!

- Removed 3 days from the game.
- Settings for graphics quality, full-screen mode, VSYNC, and frame rate limit.
- Changed the location of the order notes.
- Improved all item container collisions.
- Minor fixes and updates to dialogue.
- Minor changes to the event timings.
- Fixed localized labels for rotten ingredients.
- Fixed a character animation bug.
- Fixed order notes not disappearing after the customers leave.
- Fixed a minor visual bug with the rain effect.
- Fixed duped knife on load game.
- Fixed some bread properties not loading properly on load game.

notes.title: v1.08 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Greatly improved putting down items.
- Improved knife and living area table collisions.
- Graphics optimizations.
- Updated recipe note location.
- Minor visual improvement to one of the endings.
- Minor updates to the dialogue.
- Added blocker setdressing for unreachable areas.
- Made extra ingredients that are for role-playing purposes look distinct on the order clipboard.
- Fixed the stretching on the cold room box textures.
- Fixed shower valves missing sound effects.
- Fixed not being able to clean litter, this time for real.

notes.title: v1.07 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Improved NPC navigation.
- Improved cheese slicing.
- Improved margarine hitbox.
- Fixed some of the NPC navigation issues.
- Fixed one of the endings not awarding a Steam achievement.
- Fixed bread rot not displaying when the bread is opened or cut in half.

notes.title: v1.06 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Made litter always visible as an interactive object instead of only when a broom is held.
- Fixed litter spawning on surfaces other than the floor.
- Fixed litter sometimes can't be cleaned.

notes.title: v1.05 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Minor environmental changes for a more consistent look and better highlighted recipe note.
- Day start hour randomization.
- Made a few objects interactable with a full hand.
- Fixed some grammar and typo issues.
- Fixed missing Turkish letters.
- Fixed a bug with a random event.
- Fixed cold room AC not affecting cold air effect.
- Fixed item preview is visible in mirror reflections.
- Fixed no resolution crunch on the main menu.

notes.title: An oopsie in the last hotfix
notes.notes:
We have forgotten a debug object that we use internally in the last version of the game.

This is fixed. Please update your game for the fix to apply.

We're really sorry about that! Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: v1.04 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Added Steam achievements for the endings.
- Added Turkish localization for The Second Coming by William Butler Yeats. (The fact that the poem was in its original language was intended, but after giving it a second thought, we wanted everyone to understand it)
- Fixed sensitivity settings are not being reapplied when booting up the game.
- Fixed a special character not clearing their service point after they are left.
- Fixed whole open bread losing its ingredients when cut in half.

notes.title: v1.03 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Added use limit to ketchup and mayonnaise bottles.
- Added a way to switch searchlight when it's held.
- Fixed holding an invisible item when an item container is clicked.
- Fixed radio playing sounds when changing the frequency and it's not powered on
- Fixed initiating a conversation with a few characters before they automatically initiate it, causing them to walk away
- Fixed non-localized starting dialogue and mouse sensitivity setting label
- Fixed a sound effect that didn't obey the master volume
- Fixed customers sometimes trying to get to the occupied service spots
- Fixed a bug regarding a random event.
- Fixed boxes not restoring their open/closed status on load game
- Fixed light making break sound again on load game
- Fixed freezer room control panel not restoring its state on load game
- Fixed tost machine not restoring its open and on/off states on load game
- Fixed radio not restoring its frequency to the correct location on load game

notes.title: v1.02 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Added an initial phone call to mention about the recipe note.
- Added a mouse sensitivity option to the settings menu.
- Moved the controls legend to a separate option in the pause menu.
- Changed the customer behavior to check the whole service counter instead of their half.
- Changed the customer behavior to wait for their turn when the service counter is full.
- Fixed cheese slices appearing inside other objects.
- Fixed customers trying to go to the wrong service point.
- Fixed being able to pick up tosts before the customers can take them.
- Fixed a few ending-related bugs.
- Fixed wrong naming on one of the endings.
- Fixed temperature values going off-limits.
- Fixed not being able to put items in the containers when aimed at an item that's already inside that container.
- Fixed items detaching from their containers on load game.
- Fixed items not preserving their temperature and rot values on load game.
- Fixed day 10 customers' shorter waiting times.
- Fixed a character facing wrong direction on day 10.
- Fixed a phone bug that happened when the player opens the phone before it rings.

notes.title: v1.01 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
- Fixed a TV event.
- Fixed a TV bug where TV audio started playing after unpausing the game.
- Removed some leftover debug shortcuts.
